feeds.title: Woodcreaft.ca Blog
feeds.description: Over thirty years ago, Woodcraft started a company with a straightforward name and a simple philosophy. They were the kind of people who would buy well-styled, reasonably priced, custom-crafted, solid wood furniture if they offered it for sale. They've crafted and finished thousands of dining tables, beds, dressers, and cabinets - all shapes and sizes and colors of every kind of furniture - and each piece was made to order for a customer. Browse their blog and learn more about services, articles, testimonials, and more.

feeds.title: Bondars Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Bondars Furniture works with designers and home owners, and a team of experienced and dedicates sales staff has helped to furnish thousands of homes across the city and country. This combined with our dedication to superior customer service ensures our customers come back time and time again.

feeds.title: Stoney Creek Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Be Inspired! Stoney Creek Furniture offers you the largest and latest selection of designer furniture, from contemporary to cottage, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Holsag Blog
feeds.description: Holsag wooden chairs are made exclusively from 100% European Beech Hardwood. Keep up with all the latest industry trends. We use mortise and tenon joints which are glued, pinned, and screwed into the frame to create a chair that will not creek and wobble. Find helpful tips and tricks for your space and industry on our blog.

feeds.title: InSTYLE Home & Rugs Blog
feeds.description: Since its inception by its founder Alvin Pourvakil in 2003, InSTYLE Home & Rugs has been your complete modern home furnishings source for the best design, quality, service, and price for the past 20 years. We specialize in contemporary furnishings in Toronto, for living rooms, dining areas, and bedrooms, as well as multifunctional furniture pieces such as sofas and sectionals, sofa beds, ottomans, Home office desks, extendable dining tables, dining chairs, bar and kitchen counter stools, entertainment tv units, mirrors and decorative paintings and much more.

feeds.title: Polanco Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Polanco Home Furniture & Interior Decor Solutions is an award-winning, family-owned business in operation since 1999. Our product specialist is Canadian-made furniture and our clients are our top priority. Our goal is to build long-lasting relationships with our clients. We offer all of the products you require for your home including sofas, sectionals, ottomans, chairs, dining & coffee tables, beds, toss cushions, lighting & more.

feeds.title: Mobler Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Since opening our doors in 1993, our commitment to our clients, and our passion for modern design has remained at the core of everything we do. We believe in building lifelong relationships and improving our customers' lives through great design. Our goal was to provide a comfortable atmosphere for every customer that allows you to visualize how each piece would look inside your own home.

feeds.title: Chervin Furniture & Design Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is to provide extraordinary furniture with the highest aesthetics and exceptional quality to share with you and your family. Our group of companies constantly strives to improve the quality, construction, and styling while offering excellent value and incomparable service to our customers.

feeds.title: Canadian Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Since 1986, our family has been an integral part of Canada's furniture industry, helping Canadians design their dream homes. Our brand offers a curated collection of Canadian-made home furnishings carefully crafted by hand, especially for you.

feeds.title: Birchwood Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Birchwood Furniture Galleries started as and continues to be a family-run business. We can say with confidence that our furniture holds its own against the best the world has to offer. Our products are designed for style, built to last, and say something special about those who own and display them.

feeds.title: Payless Furniture Blog
feeds.description: At Payless Furniture, our mission is to make high-quality furniture accessible to everyone without extra hassle or cost. Our goal is to create a seamless shopping experience, allowing you to furnish your space with remarkable ease. Our team is composed of skilled individuals who have extensive knowledge and experience, making us well-equipped to handle your pieces with care.

feeds.title: Q Living Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Q Living Furniture is an expanding home goods store specializing in the living room, dining room, bedroom, and outdoor furniture. We are a small, independently owned furniture store in an era of tech companies turned furniture sellers. We work hard to bring value to the furniture industry, with a fresh perspective on function and style.

feeds.title: Berkshire Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Established in June 1999 Berkshire Furniture is a 100% Canadian-owned and operated company. Our principal goal is to offer Quality Furniture at Very Affordable prices and at the same time provide excellent customer service. Our mission is to bring you the best products at the most affordable prices with exceptional service.

feeds.title: Autonomous Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Autonomous Furniture designs and produces all of its products in Victoria, BC in our downtown studio and showroom. Our furniture line is made up of around 20 pieces at any given time, updated with a new piece approximately every six months. We are designers and craftsmen, disrupting the modern home with dramatically contemporary furnishings, built from the finest wood in the world.

feeds.title: McElheran's Blog
feeds.description: We understand that selecting new furniture is a big decision. Our first-class Design Guides are here to make the process personal and easy. We believe home should be the perfect setting for memories to be made and life to be enjoyed. We have a world of exclusive options at our fingertips. Your dream pieces are out there, and we'll help you find them.

feeds.title: HD Threshing Blog
feeds.description: We custom build to any size or style depending on your space. Check out our blog to see examples of our recent projects featuring custom-built furniture made with reclaimed wood.

feeds.title: Luxmood Luxury Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Luxmood features the finest luxury furniture in Toronto and home décor from the most exclusive European Artisans. Our Company pairs traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design, bringing luxury and elegance to your living room at a fraction of the price of traditional designer sofas and furniture.
